folder-not-mapped: The themes folder ({path}) isn't mapped to a folder on the host, so added packs and this setting are lost when the container is recreated.
folder-not-writable: The themes folder ({path}) is read-only, so the selection can't be saved.
load-failed: Could not load the theme packs
own-choice: This browser uses its own theme choice. Open the theme picker and choose "Server's theme" to follow this setting.
preview-hint: Opens RomM with this theme in a new tab without saving anything
refresh: Reload the list from the themes folder
saved: Theme saved and packs reloaded. Reload the page to see the change.
stock-description: RomM's own look, with no theme applied
subtitle: Theme packs come from the themes folder mapped into the container. Add or edit packs there, then choose one and save to apply it for everyone who hasn't picked their own theme.
title: Server theme
